arm_notes.baseline: Whole-file reads. The weaker of the two controls, kept for comparability with v0.1.0.
arm_notes.linerange: Precise line-range reads: rg to locate, sed -n 'START,ENDp' to read. The disciplined baseline a competent agent actually uses. Added because the v0.1.0 spec pre-registered it as owed once the cost ratio came in under 0.25.

cache.note: Only callers and dead read or write .agentlens-cache. map, find, slice, literals and packet parse on demand and are unaffected by cache state. Warming changes latency, never output: the cold and warm runs below are byte-identical, so the token cost this benchmark reports does not depend on cache state.

falsification.note: Pre-registered before the v0.2.0 run. agentlens fails if it misses any condition against either control.

vs_baseline.rationale: Unchanged from v0.1.0 so the two campaigns stay comparable.

vs_linerange.rationale: Looser than the baseline threshold on purpose. Arm C pays for precise reads but still pays for the searches that locate the lines, so a modest rather than dramatic advantage is the honest prior. Demanding a 2x win against the disciplined control would be setting a bar we had no reason to expect.

verification_corrections: Added the missing django/ prefix to draft source addresses.

M04 was changed from middleware __call__ returning None to a view or process_template_response returning None because the draft gold addressed check_response, which does not validate general middleware return values.
M08 primary gold now names process_exception_by_middleware and convert_exception_to_response directly.
M10 primary gold adds process_response, where APPEND_SLASH-only redirects occur.
L01 includes both synchronous and asynchronous handler paths.

L04 and L06 now target Django's actual AuthenticationMiddleware/LoginRequiredMiddleware startup ordering check and its tests; the drafted security/base.py and handler test locations did not contain that behavior.
